response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, including C++ in a relevant context (NI LabWindows/CVI), but his recent work has been heavily focused on web/mobile technologies (Node.js, TypeScript, React) rather than C++ or industrial automation. His lack of recent C++ experience and cloud/messaging-broker expertise raises concerns about immediate role fit. However, his broad technical background, problem-solving skills, and open-source contributions demonstrate strong potential.
strengths: Strong C++ and STL experience from National Instruments role (critical for core competency)
Proven ability to architect scalable, high-performance systems (e.g., micro-services infrastructure at dunnhumby)
Deep knowledge of testing methodologies (TDD, CI/CD) and software craftsmanship practices
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (last significant work in 2015; no mention of modern C++11/14/17/20 features)
No direct experience with industrial automation protocols (Modbus, IEC 61850, etc.) or cloud platforms (Azure)
No documented experience with message brokers (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ) or event-driven architectures in C++
